action.LiftVehicleRestriction: Lift vehicle posting restriction after verification

list.descriptionStaff: Receive, verify, and track the resolution outcome of violation reports.
list.descriptionMine: Track the verification progress and resolution outcome of the reports you submitted.
list.emptyFiltered: Try changing or clearing the filters to find the case you need.
list.emptyDefault: You can submit a report from your account profile, vehicle details, or a booking.

detail.bookingNotice: Resolving a report only determines the behavior. The booking, contract, deposit, and refunds stay unchanged. Financial requests must be handled in <link>Disputes</link>.
detail.noEvidence: The reporter didn't attach evidence. Verify further before applying measures.
detail.progressNote: Our moderation team will review the information and post the outcome here. Internal details and staff identities aren't shown to the reporter.
detail.claimHint: Claim the case before acting. Every conclusion needs clear verification grounds.
detail.noActions: No actions available. The case is closed, owned by someone else, or has a conflict of interest.
detail.privacy: Keep the reporter's information confidential when discussing and concluding the case.
detail.noticeSuspend: The account will move to Suspended and active sessions will be revoked. Existing bookings and financial obligations stay unchanged. Admin only.
detail.noticeHideVehicle: The vehicle listing will be hidden from public listings and blocked from new bookings. Existing bookings continue per the trip process.
detail.noticeReopen: Reopening a case doesn't undo warnings, account locks, or vehicle hides already applied. If restoration is needed, verify and use the target management page.
detail.noticeLiftVehicle: Only lift the restriction after confirming the fix. The vehicle keeps its current status and isn't relisted automatically. The reason will be sent to the vehicle owner.
detail.resolutionLabelLift: Reason for lifting the restriction, sent to the owner *
detail.resolutionPlaceholder: State the verification grounds, conclusion, and measures (20–2000 characters). This content may be sent to the sanctioned party.
detail.confirmCheck: I've reviewed the information, verified the grounds, and confirm this resolution decision.
detail.staleHint: If the case has changed, close the dialog and choose “Reload case”.

snapshot.unreadable: Couldn't read the information saved at report time.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't complete the action. Please try again.
